profile.headline: Software Developer leveraging workload prioritization and data organization skills.
profile.summary: Goal-driven professional with 20+ years of experience combining advanced computer skills with a collaborative, team-oriented approach to excel in high-pressure, detail-focused environments. Expertise in managing and analyzing large data sets, scheduling, and overseeing all facets of program operations. Eager to apply creative and critical thinking to contribute to the success of the right organization.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Collaborate with program subject matter experts, key stakeholders, cross-functional teams, and end-users to understand the program needs, identify areas of improvement, and to review and analyze system requirements and user stories.
• Apply agile method and industry best practices to develop, document, and deploy tools that enhanced processes and communication across the program by leveraging the Atlassian Data Center Tool Suite (Jira, Confluence, etc.) and relevant add-ons to build solutions tailored to team needs and business requirements.
• Incorporate functionality and optimized workflows within Communities of Interest (COI) and Communities of Practice (CoP) to align with industry best practices.
• Provide comprehensive support for end-user applications within the Atlassian Suite, including Jira Software, Jira Service Desk, Assets, and Confluence.
• Develop and provide end-user training for the Atlassian tools and customized products for individuals, small groups, and product owners.
• Proactively troubleshoot and overcome technical problems.
• Manage requirement elicitation meetings, review boards, and functional demonstrations.
• Work with end-users and customers to enable custom workflows, fields, screens, dashboards, and reports.
• Utilize SQL to extract data from relational databases and Assets Query Language (AQL) for data extraction and filtering within Jira Assets.
• Customize automations for Jira Service Desk Assets data.
• Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot customized scripting of Jira Workflow automations.
• Create and sustain requirements, development, deployment guide, test plan, and workflow documentation and procedures related to current project(s).
• Configure and manage the Confluence instance and the Jira instance and projects.
• Create import configurations with object mapping for Jira Service Desk Assets data.
• Work with Jira application data to create advanced reporting solutions in Confluence.

positions.title: Configuration Data Manager
positions.description:
•  Perform as liaison for all Configuration/Data Management (CM/DM) matters for Objective Simulation Framework (OSF)/Single Stimulation Framework (SSF) HW/SW.
•  Manage, prioritize, work, and track assigned issues through Jira.
•  Organize and share files, manage document versions in CM repositories on both Confluence and SharePoint platforms.
•  Experience with TDP development using AutoCAD and Microsoft Vizio software.
•  Support software builds, DES Hardware Configuration Control Board, and Quality Assurance personnel.
•  Media creation and distribution.
•  Ensure Document Management procedures are utilized.
•  Maintain Jira Assets with hardware configuration data.
•  Develop processes and procedures for Quality Assurance and CM/DM products.
•  Perform software and hardware audits.
•  Created and published Confluence “How to”/training articles to complete CM/DM processes and tasks within Jira.
•  Created and published an exportable FedEx Shipping PDF form to be automatically filled with information from a Jira issue within JSM.

positions.title: Configuration Management II
positions.description:
•	Provide CM/DM consultation, advice, & guidance to ensure the success of the Mars Accent Vehicle (MAV) project and Microgravity & Life Sciences Glovebox (MLSG) projects.
•	Acting Lead when Government Lead was unavailable or out of office.
•	Provide CM/DM support per MSFC best practices identified in MGM 7120.3 & MGM 8040.1 or as noted by industry.
•	Develop & maintain charters for control boards, provide secretariat support to develop & maintain agendas, minutes, directive actions, logs, & records
•	Provide support to the Change Package Manager (CPM)
•	Develop and maintain CM/DM related work instructions
•	Support to NQA and other audits.
•	Provide CM/DM audit support, including the development of audit plans
•	Provide Data Quality Assurance (DQA).
•	Utilize and provide expert guidance as to the use of Government-provided WIKI and/or data storage systems, as required.
•	Maintain appropriate data availability & security markings for products.
•	Collect, retain, maintain, & prepare data records information for distribution to internal & external customers to meet project goals.
•	Perform integration & analysis of data, products, and system tools
•	Support programmatic reviews, technical meetings & associated technical briefings, & track & report on activities and products.
•	Provide records management & archival in accordance with MPR 1440.2.
•	Develop & make recommendations for improvements to data management processes, including data organization, identification, control, & maintenance procedures.
•	Develop & make recommendations for improvements to configuration management processes, systems & activities including change management.
•	Scanning, organizing, cataloging, labeling, indexing, & quality check for files from hard copy to electronic media, as required.
•	Lead activities & coordinate with other project team members as needed to develop & produce requested deliverables.
•	Develop, mange, update, & maintain CM/DM SharePoint sites.
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Workload Prioritization · Data Management · Data Organization · Adobe Acrobat · SharePoint Administration

positions.title: System Analyst II
positions.description:
• Provide support to program and mission at Advanced Research Center (ARC) government facility, Missile Defense Agency (MDA) ARC Test Data & Lab Management ICN.
• Plan, prioritize, & organize a diversified workload in a high-pace detail-oriented environment.
• Coordinate allocation & deconfliction of test assets with ARC Senior Management and Government personnel.
• Complete analysis of Integrated Master Test Plan (IMTP) status charts for test configurations.
• Interface with Managers, Integrators, & Logistics/Technical/Business representatives to receive schedule inputs and integrate inputs into the schedule.
• Provide IMTP Truth and Tactical Comms Interface (TTCI) Document to appropriate personnel.
• Manage, organize, & update ARC lab configuration charts.
• Possess knowledge of Configuration Management concepts.
• Manage, monitor, organize, & analyze ARC Requests (AR) and Cyber Security Software Reviews (CSSR) for requirements, completion dates, and other data processing information.
• Coordinate with ARC Lab Managers to update ARs.
• Access, create, & manage program documentation.
• Perform activities that support Risk Management Framework controls within ARC Test and Development Environment.
• Track software & hardware install milestones for ARC readiness and Contract Data Requirements List (CDRL).
• Add ARC specific predecessors and tie to predetermined IMTP phases.
• CDRL items:
   o Develop & sustain detailed MS Project and high level MS PowerPoint ARC Ballistic Missile Defense Systems (BMDS) Integrated Master Schedule (IMS).
   o Create, maintain, compile, format, & update weekly MS Project/PowerPoint status briefing of technical and non-technical activities deliverable to ICN leadership.
   o Create, maintain, & provide weekly ARC specific project schedule for IMTP, Non-IMTP, & equipment installations events.
   o Extract, collect, & provide stats on ARs and CSSRs monthly, quarterly, annually, & by request organized by type, Government agency, & duration.

positions.title: System Analyst I
positions.description:
• Coordinate with ARC Asset Manager to maintain BMDS IMS for ARC.
• Assist with data management, data organization, data management concepts and development of procedures.
• Coordinate allocation and deconfliction of test assets with ARC Asset Manager.
• Participate in the preparation of schedules for all contract work.
• Generate Integrated Master Schedule formats and outputs as required by ARC Asset Manager and Government customer.
• Create, maintain, and provide detailed MS Project and high-level MS Power Point integrated master schedule daily for events, lab tech refreshes, and new equipment receival and installs to ARC Asset Manager and Government customer weekly or upon request in between deliverable date per CDRL.
• Track ARC specific predecessors on MS project schedules to ensure ARC readiness.
• Develop and support maintenance of ARC lab configuration charts.
• Manage, coordinate, monitor, organize, and analyze ARC Requests and CSSRs for management review.
• Implement data management in the electronic environment which includes establishing file/folder structures, capturing meta data, and creating input forms.
• ARC Security department: inventories and file visit authorization requests.
• Escort foreign and domestic personnel per MDA guidelines and regulations.
• Manage ARC contract, project, user and account data in the ARC User Services 2000 Access database.
• Coordinate setup or locking of user accounts in accordance with (IAW) security guide.
• Send out monthly notifications of expiring contracts, user's account access, and ARC events: network and system maintenance, scheduled outages, and other IT operations.
• Coordinate schedule for ARC meeting rooms and any special requirements.
• Manage ARC temporary workspace utilization to determine approval, length of access, and required resources for contractor and government personnel.
• Support ARC Helpdesk to include basic system troubleshooting, diagnosis, and correction or routing for specific assistance.

positions.title: Program Analyst Administrator I
positions.description:
• Executive Assistant to Program Director (PD) and Deputy Program Director (DPD) of MDA, Sensors Directorate (SN) and coordinate schedules as required.
• Active member to SN Staff Action Group to the X-Band Radar Project Office (SNX).
• Use independent judgment to plan, prioritize, and organize a diversified workload in a high-pace and detail-oriented environment.
• Coordinate and set up classified and unclassified meetings, teleconferences, and Video Teleconferences (VTC).
• Create and enter travel orders in Defense Travel System. Ensure all travel is following Department of Defense (DoD) travel policies and regulations, to include foreign travel. Complete travel vouchers, packages, and agendas for temporary duty activities for SN personnel.
• Submit country clearance requests for travelers and serve as office point of contact for foreign personnel on official visit and for SN personnel visiting foreign countries.
• Maintain Entry Access List in Defense Messaging System and Aircraft and Personnel Automated Clearance System. Provide information and assistance on submittal of visit authorization requests for visitors.
• Review correspondence for procedural and grammatical accuracy.
• Create and format documents via Microsoft Office applications and Adobe Acrobat per IAW DoD Regulations.
• Action officer to manage incoming and outgoing actions through an electronic program and tracking system.
• Ensure classified documentation is stored and handled IAW DoD security policies and regulations.

positions.title: Program Analyst I
positions.description:
• Assist the stand up of new Sensors Directorate and move to Von Braun II government facility.
• Support SNX’s Execution Cell team (originally Ground-based Midcourse X-Band Radar project office).
• Assist with data management, data organization, data management concepts.
• Perform secretarial functions to meet project office mission requirements.
• Prepare incoming actions, accept, and assign or decline through E-Tasker automated system.
• Assist with technical and non-technical writings in response to E-Taskers.
• Ensure classified materials are secured in accordance with IAW DoD policies and regulations.
• Handle administrative security issues of incoming and outgoing classified documents.
• Implement data management in the electronic environment to include establishing file/folder structures, capturing meta data, and creating input forms.
• Manage the scheduling of facility resources for teleconferences, meetings, VTCs.
• Provide and prepare correspondence within SNX and related offices.
• Develop and maintain master SNX calendar of leave, TDY, or alternate work schedule.
• Complete in and out-processing of personnel.
• Create and present for management employee awards or certificates nominations.
• Create templates for common processes and documents.
• Create and maintain SNX training tracking database.
• Provide general computer and software training and basic troubleshooting.

positions.title: Accounts Payable Clerk
positions.description:
• Enter accounts payable (AP) Aeronautics Division (AD) expense reports, AP invoices, purchase orders, voucher corrections and AP Legacy Division (LD) freight company charges into Cost Point financial database.
• Responsible for payable and back-up data of the AD American Express charges, created and maintained old and current files.
• Create reports on expense reports, invoices, and purchase orders.
• Match and file expense reports for LD.
• Input customer invoices to corporate system, verify complete documentation, submit to Division Controller for review and approval, reconcile FAX documents to original documents, and forward documents to accounts receivable.
• Analyze and evaluate payable invoices and purchase orders from both departments, created reports for expense reports, invoices and purchase orders. 
• Audit reports for both AD and LD.
• Evaluate and process direct deposits for travel expense reimbursements.

positions.title: Customer Service Representative II
positions.description:
• Process payments; creation of new service; changes to existing services; troubleshoot local, long distance, and cellular services.
• Plan, organize, prioritize work, and coordinate with other representatives to effectively meet the daily call volume.
• Delineate, analyze, and evaluate fact-finding investigations of services and billing issues implementing resolutions and provide results orally and written to management team, client, and other representatives.
• Project improving GCI's Intranet operation instructions of new Avaya multi line phone system and details of computer interface requirements.
• Routinely selected for special project teams.
• Create training materials for and provide computer and software training to temp-hires and new-hires.
• Provide basic hardware and software troubleshooting to customers and co-workers.

positions.title: Insurance Sales Representative
positions.description:
• Provide home and auto quotes.
• Prepare bank deposit and controlled cash box.
• Process payments, analyze, evaluate, and complete changes to existing policies and maintain verbal and written correspondence.
• Train staff on specialized company database and implement software updates.
• Work with database designer to troubleshoot and implement corrective coding, configuration, and application deployment to support working process and improve efficiency.

positions.title: Engineering Technician, GS 802 Summer Intern
positions.description:
• Process statistical data into specialized analysis program to determine accuracy of probes.
• Manipulate Rocky Mountain Basic computer language to alter program.
• Tutor co-worker in C++ programming language.
• Work calibration of radiation probes utilizing precise calibration techniques.
